primary_metric: validation normalized MSE after flooring predicted physical speed at zero
same_target_times: all windows predict from split-relative index 31 onward; no cross-split histories
target_normalization: same training mean/std as tutorial using training targets starting at index 7
screen: 16 neural configurations, seeds 0 and 1; ridge alpha grid
confirmation: top configurations plus original baseline on fresh seeds 2,3,4
input_followup: longer histories and larger nested neuron pools for selected design
test_policy: freeze final candidates and ensemble recipe before one final test evaluation; earlier pilot study already examined this recording so this is not a pristine external benchmark
early_stopping: after at least 12 epochs, stop after 7 evaluations without new best
